fusions.name: Filter Feeding
fusions.desc: Spits a jet that deals 4 water damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 4 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thousand Barbs
fusions.desc: Stings every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 poison damage, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. The poison spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Polyp Garden
fusions.desc: Grows a reef beside you for 15 seconds that strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each kill restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Grown Bulwark
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
